blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的表达方式越来越多地用于分享和再利用来自医疗图像的信息,而不暴露原始扫描,但不清楚这些表达方式保留了多少针对患者的信息. 我们对大脑磁共振成像(MRI)的这个问题进行了调查,评估了5个冷冻的前置编码器,它们跨越了不同的架构、前置训练目标以及两个纵向T1加权数据集(OASIS-2和MIRIAD)的培训领域。 在一个可以访问释放的嵌入物,相应的公共编码器,以及辅助核磁共振扫描的进攻者模型下,我们评价病人的关联和敏感属性推论. 在经过评估的陈述中,我们观察到大量针对特定主题的信息:在MIRIAD上,一等病人的联系达到99+%,在OASIS-2上,风险最高的代表达到90+%,尽管在编码器培训期间没有识别目标。 我们进一步显示,释放的嵌入物保留了有关人口属性的信息,记录的性别预测在OASIS-2和MIRIAD上达到90.9XX的平衡准确度。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,用已学到的嵌入物取代生脑核磁共振本身并不能消除患者-联系或属性-推论风险,因此本身不足以确定匿名性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an imaging modality that generates detailed images of the internal structures of the body, including the brain’s anatomy. Given this level of anatomical detail, brain MRI is a routine tool in the diagnosis and monitoring of neurological and psychiatric conditions such as Alzheimer’s disease, stroke, and brain tumors ( Frisoni et al., 2010 ; Ahmed et al., 2021 ; Martucci et al., 2023 ) . Many AI models have been trained to detect and classify these conditions from brain MRI scans ( Korolev et al., 2017 ; Mohsen et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)是一种成像方式,它产生身体内部结构的详细图像,包括大脑解剖学. 鉴于这种解剖细节水平,脑磁共振是诊断和监测阿尔茨海默氏病、中风和脑瘤等神经和精神疾病的常规工具(Frisoni等,2010年;Ahmed等,2021年;Martucci等,2023年)。 许多 AI模型接受了从大脑核磁共振扫描中检测和分类这些条件的培训(克罗廖夫等,2017;莫赫森等,2018.

blocks.en:
At the same time, studies have shown that brain morphology can serve as a biometric signature, a “brain fingerprint”, which enables subject re-identification through comparison with reference data ( Wachinger et al., 2014 ; Takao et al., 2015 ; Valizadeh et al., 2018 ) .
Therefore, brain MRI has a dual nature, at once a diagnostic tool and a carrier of identifying biometric information.
blocks.zh:
同时有研究表明,大脑形态学可以作为生物特征,"大脑指纹",通过与参考数据相比较,可以重新识别对象(Wachinger等,2014;Takao等,2015;Valizadeh等,2018.).
因此,脑磁共振具有双重性质,同时是诊断工具和识别生物鉴别信息的载体。

blocks.en:
In recent years, foundation models, large neural networks trained on broad and diverse datasets, have emerged. Many of these models use self-supervised learning to learn transferable representations that can be adapted to a range of downstream tasks ( Bommasani et al., 2022 ) . This approach is especially useful for medical imaging, where labeled data can be scarce and costly to obtain. Instead of training a model from scratch, a pretrained model can be adapted to the specific task at hand with limited task-specific labeled data ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Tak et al., 2026 ) .
For brain MRI specifically, a growing body of work has explored foundation models for representation learning and downstream analysis ( Barbano et al., 2026 ; Ghamizi et al., 2025 ; Mazher et al., 2025 ) .
Throughout this paper, we refer to the vector representation produced by a pretrained encoder as an embedding .
blocks.zh:
近年来,基础模型,大型神经网络,在广泛而多样的数据集上得到训练,已经出现. 许多这些模型使用自我监督的学习来学习可以被适应一系列下游任务的可转移的表示(Bommasani等,2022年). 这种方法对医疗成像特别有用,因为贴有标签的数据很少,而且获取费用也很高。 与其从零开始训练出一个模型,不如对经过预先训练的模型进行改造,使之适应手头的具体任务,并附带有限的特定任务标签数据(Liu等,2025;Tak等,2026)。
对于大脑磁共振,越来越多的工作探索了代表性学习和下游分析的基础模式(Barbano等,2026;Ghamizi等,2025;Mazher等,2025)。
在本文中,我们提到预先训练的编码器所产生的矢量表示作为嵌入式。

blocks.en: This question is also relevant to how anonymization is assessed in practice. Recent guidelines from the European Data Protection Board (EDPB) identify three criteria for evaluating whether data can be considered anonymous: No Record Isolation, No Linkage, and No Inference ( European Data Protection Board, 2026 ) . Our study examines two corresponding technical risks for released brain MRI representations: linkage across records belonging to the same individual and inference of withheld patient attributes.
blocks.zh: 这个问题还关系到在实践中如何评估匿名问题。 欧洲数据保护委员会(EDPB)最近的准则确定了评估数据是否可以被视为匿名的三项标准: 无记录隔离,无链接,无推断(欧洲数据保护委员会,2026年). 我们的研究审查了释放出脑磁共振的两种相应的技术风险:同一个人的记录之间的联系和对患者特征的推断。

blocks.en:
As pretrained encoders are increasingly used to produce reusable representations of brain anatomy for downstream tasks, a central privacy question arises: when a learned representation is released instead of the raw brain MRI, can it still enable patient linkage or reveal additional patient-specific information? Across the evaluated models and datasets, we observe substantial variation in privacy risk, with rank-1 patient matching exceeding 90% for some representations and remaining well above chance across several model–dataset combinations.
We address this question through four contributions: • Define explicit threat models for patient linkage, re-identification, and sensitive-attribute inference from released brain MRI representations, and systematically evaluate five frozen pretrained encoders across two longitudinal MRI datasets. • Quantify identity-related information through a score-based linkability audit and an explicit rank-1 matching attack (exploiting the proximity of embeddings derived from the same patient), showing that several representations preserve substantial subject-specific information despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. • Evaluate sensitive-attribute inference from released brain MRI representations, showing that the embeddings can reveal the subject’s recorded sex in addition to supporting patient linkage. • Demonstrate that releasing embeddings instead of raw brain MRI does not, by itself, eliminate linkage or attribute-inference risk and therefore is insufficient, on its own, to establish anonymity.
blocks.zh:
由于预先训练的编码器被越来越多地用于为下游任务制作大脑解剖学的可再用表述,因此产生了一个中心隐私问题:当一个已学到的表述被放出而不是生脑核磁共振时,它能否仍然能够使患者关联,或者揭示更多的针对患者的信息? 在整个评估模型和数据集中,我们观察到隐私风险的巨大差异,一些表现的一等病人匹配率超过90%,在几个模型-数据集组合中仍然远远高于机会。
我们通过4个贡献来解决这一问题:为患者的联系、重新识别和释放的脑磁共振反应的敏感属性推论确定明确的威胁模型,并系统地评价两个纵向磁共振反应数据集的5个被冻结的预先培训编码器。 • 通过基于分数的可连通性审计和明确的一级匹配攻击来量化与身份有关的信息(探索来自同一名病人的嵌入物的相近性),表明尽管在编码器培训中缺乏识别目标,但若干表述保留了针对具体主题的实质性信息。 · 评价释放出脑磁共振反应的敏感属性推论,表明嵌入物除了支持患者的关联外,还可以揭示被试者记录的性别。 • 证明释放嵌入物而不是生脑磁共振本身并不能消除关联或属性推论风险,因此本身并不足以确定匿名。

blocks.en: Define explicit threat models for patient linkage, re-identification, and sensitive-attribute inference from released brain MRI representations, and systematically evaluate five frozen pretrained encoders across two longitudinal MRI datasets.
blocks.zh: 从释放的大脑核磁共振示意图中,为患者联系、重新识别和敏感属性推论确定明确的威胁模型,并系统地评价两个纵向核磁共振数据集的5个被冻结的先行编码器。

blocks.en: Quantify identity-related information through a score-based linkability audit and an explicit rank-1 matching attack (exploiting the proximity of embeddings derived from the same patient), showing that several representations preserve substantial subject-specific information despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training.
blocks.zh: 通过基于分数的关联性审计和明确的一级匹配攻击(探索出同一患者所衍生出嵌入的相近性)量化身份相关信息,表明尽管在编码器培训中缺乏识别目标,但多处表述保留了实质性的针对具体主题的信息.

blocks.en: Evaluate sensitive-attribute inference from released brain MRI representations, showing that the embeddings can reveal the subject’s recorded sex in addition to supporting patient linkage.
blocks.zh: 评估释放出脑磁共振反应的敏感属性推论,表明嵌入物除了支持患者的关联外,还可以揭示被试者记录的性别.

blocks.en: Demonstrate that releasing embeddings instead of raw brain MRI does not, by itself, eliminate linkage or attribute-inference risk and therefore is insufficient, on its own, to establish anonymity.
blocks.zh: 证明释放嵌入物而不是生脑核磁共振本身并不能消除关联或属性推论风险,因此本身不足以确定匿名性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Privacy risks in brain MRI :
Historically, safeguarding patient privacy in medical imaging, as required by privacy regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) European Parliament and Council of the European Union (2016) , Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) Government of Canada (2000) , and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) California State Legislature (2026) , has involved removing direct identifiers from medical data before secondary use or disclosure. In medical imaging, this typically includes stripping metadata such as names, birth dates, and medical record numbers from image headers. However, medical images themselves still contain detailed clinical and anatomical information, and patient-specific traces may remain even after obvious identifiers are removed ( RSNA, ) .
blocks.zh:
脑磁共振中的隐私风险:
历史上,根据《一般数据保护条例》、欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会(2016年)、《个人信息保护和电子文件法》(PIPEDA)加拿大政府(2000年)和《加利福尼亚消费者隐私法》(CAPA)加利福尼亚州议会(2026年)等隐私条例的要求,保护患者在医疗成像方面的隐私,涉及在二次使用或披露之前从医疗数据中删除直接识别资料。 在医疗成像中,这通常包括从图像头取出姓名、出生日期和医疗记录号码等去除元数据。 然而,医疗图像本身仍然包含详细的临床和解剖信息,即使在清除出明显的识别特征之后,病人特有的痕迹也可能依然存在(RSNA,.).

blocks.en: Brain MRIs, for instance, capture detailed facial anatomy, which makes 3D facial reconstruction and therefore identification via face-recognition deep learning achievable. ( Boutet et al., 2023 ) demonstrated that faces reconstructed in 3D from brain MRI scans could be matched against public photos using deep learning, effectively exposing a person’s identity. To guard against this, techniques like defacing are commonly used ( Gulban et al., 2020 ; Mitew et al., 2024 ) . Yet defacing does not fully eliminate the risk either: deep learning can still reconstruct a plausible face from a defaced scan ( Jeong et al., 2020 ; Abramian & Eklund, 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 例如,大脑MRI,捕捉到详细的面部解剖,这使得3D面部重建,从而通过面部识别的深入学习来识别. (Boutet等人,2023年)证明,通过脑磁共振扫描在3D中重建的面孔可以与公众照片相匹配,通过深入学习,有效地暴露一个人的身份. 为了防止这种情况,通常使用诽谤等技术(Gulban等,2020年;Mitew等,2024年)。 然而,诽谤也不能完全消除风险:深层学习仍然可以从被抹去的扫描中重建出一个可信的面孔(Jeong等人,2020年;Abramian & Eklund,2019年)。

blocks.en:
The problem is not limited to the face. Research has shown that the shape of the brain itself can serve as an identifying signature, a “brain fingerprint”. Wachinger et al. (2014) developed BrainPrint, a technique that uses brain shape to identify individuals with near-perfect accuracy. Valizadeh et al. (2018) found that brain features remain distinctive and stable even across years.
DeepBrainPrint ( Puglisi et al., 2023 ) explicitly trained a contrastive representation for longitudinal brain MRI re-identification, showing that learned representations can also encode stable subject-specific information across scans.
More recently, Bajar et al. (2026) reinforced this finding by testing four defacing methods on brain scans; even after defacing, subjects were still re-identified 66–73% of the time using brain-feature-based similarity attacks.
Taken together, these findings show that brain MRI can reveal identity in more than one way through brain features even after defacing methods have been applied.
blocks.zh:
问题不仅限于面相. 研究表明,大脑本身的形状可以作为识别特征,即"大脑指纹". Wachinger等人(2014年)开发了BrainPrint,这是一种使用大脑外形来识别具有接近完美准确性的个人的技术. Valizadeh等人(2018年)发现,即使在多年内,大脑的特征也依然独特而稳定.
深大脑打印 (Puglisi等,2023年)明确培训了纵向脑磁共振再识别的对比性表示法,表明所学的表示法还可以将稳定的主题特定信息编码到整个扫描.
最近,Bajar等人(2026年)通过在脑扫描上测试四种诽谤方法强化了这一发现;即使在被诽谤后,实验对象仍然在66-73%的时间里被重新识别,使用基于大脑的相似性攻击.
综合起来,这些调查结果表明,即使在应用了诽谤方法之后,大脑核磁共振能够以不止一种方式通过大脑特征揭示身份。

blocks.en:
Medical foundation models :
Brain MRI foundation models can be broadly grouped according to their pretraining objective. Task-agnostic models are pretrained without a specific downstream task in mind; they rely on self-supervised objectives to learn general-purpose representations that can later be fine-tuned for various tasks ( Barbano et al., 2026 ; Kaczmarek et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Caron et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
医疗基础模型:
大脑核磁共振基础模型可以根据其前期训练目标进行广泛的分组. 任务不可知模型在未想到具体下游任务的情况下进行预先培训;它们依靠自我监督的目标来学习一般目的的表述,这些表述日后可以细化用于各种任务(Barbano等,2026;Kaczmarek等,2025;Huang等,2025;Caron等,2021).

blocks.en: Task-specific foundation models, in contrast, are pretrained around a particular downstream objective, most often segmentation ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Cox et al., 2024 ) . Their encoders are therefore shaped by this task rather than by the goal of producing general-purpose representations. We evaluate representative models from these different paradigms; their architectures and pretraining objectives are described in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 相比之下,针对具体任务的基础模型是围绕特定下游目标预先训练的,最常见的是分化(Wang等人,2024;Cox等人,2024)。 因此,它们的编码器是由这项任务而不是由产生一般用途表述的目标所决定的。 我们从这些不同的范式来评价代表性模式;其结构和培训前目标在第3.1节中作了说明。

blocks.en: Privacy risks for medical foundation models : Nebbia et al. (2025) showed that representations extracted from frozen medical foundation models can support patient retrieval in fundus photography, OCT, and chest X-ray, and can also expose demographic attributes. However, it does not define a threat model. Also, subsequent work questioned whether some of these results reflect properties specific to foundation models or simpler acquisition and image-level similarity, highlighting the importance of carefully specifying the attacker and evaluation protocol ( Engelmann et al., 2026 ) . More broadly, learned representations are known to expose sensitive information beyond their intended downstream objective ( Song & Shmatikov, 2019 ) , and recent work has emphasized the importance of explicit attacker knowledge and disclosure assumptions when evaluating clinical foundation models ( Tonekaboni et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 医疗基础模型的隐私风险: Nebbia等 (2025) 显示从被冻结的医疗基础模型中提取的表示可以支持Fundus摄影,OCT,和胸X光中的患者取回,也可以暴露出人口属性. 然而,它没有界定威胁模式。 此外,随后的工作还质疑其中一些结果是否反映了基础模型特有的属性,还是更简单的获取和图像级别相似性,并凸显了仔细指定攻击者和评价协议的重要性(Engelmann等,2026年). 更广义地说,已知所学的表述暴露出超出其预期下游目标的敏感信息(Song & Shmatikov, 2019),而近期的工作也强调了在评价临床基础模型时明确攻击者知识和披露假设的重要性(Tonekaboni等, 2026年).

blocks.en: Summary: Our work connects two previously separate observations: brain anatomy is individually distinctive, acting as a biometric trait, and reusable learned representations can leak information beyond their intended purpose. Focusing on longitudinal brain MRI, we evaluate whether frozen pretrained encoders enable both patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference, explicitly separating linkability from re-identification threat models. By quantifying how much these representations expose patients to re-identification, we highlight the need for stronger safeguards and greater awareness as such models are released as open-source resources and made widely accessible.
blocks.zh: 摘要:我们的工作连接了先前两个独立的观测结果:脑解剖学具有个性化特征,起到生物特征的作用,可重复使用所学到的表达可以泄露超出预期目的的信息. 以纵向脑磁共振为重点,我们评价被冷冻的前置编码器是否既能使病人联系,又能使敏感属性推论得以实现,同时明确区分可联系性和再识别威胁模型. 通过量化这些表述使患者能够重新识别的程度,我们强调需要加强保障并提高认识,因为这些模型作为开放源码资源发布并广泛提供。

blocks.en: 3 Threat Model and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 威胁模型和实验设置

blocks.en: This section describes the experimental setting used to evaluate privacy risks in pretrained brain MRI representations. We first introduce the evaluated encoders and longitudinal datasets, then formalize the attacker capabilities and privacy threats, and finally describe the embedding extraction, linkage, attribute-inference, and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍用于评估预受训练的脑磁共振表现中隐私风险的实验设置. 我们首先介绍被评价的编码器和纵向数据集,然后将攻击器的能力和隐私威胁正式化,并最后描述嵌入式提取,链接,属性推论,和评价协议.

blocks.en: 3.1 Models and datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 模型和数据集

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate five pretrained encoders that differ in pretraining domain, input dimensionality, architecture, and objective (Table 1 ): AnatCL ( Barbano et al., 2026 ) , 3D-Neuro-SimCLR ( Kaczmarek et al., 2025 ) , Brain-MRI-SSL ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , DINO-ViT ( Caron et al., 2021 ) , and SAM-Med3D ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . The first three were pretrained specifically on brain MRI, whereas DINO-ViT was pretrained on natural images and SAM-Med3D on heterogeneous medical images. AnatCL, 3D-Neuro-SimCLR, and SAM-Med3D process full 3D volumes, while Brain-MRI-SSL and DINO-ViT operate on 2D images. Most models are trained with self-supervised objectives to learn general-purpose representations, whereas SAM-Med3D is trained specifically for segmentation in a supervised way. The models also use different loss objectives for their training. For instance, AnatCL is trained with weakly contrastive loss that combines two terms: an anatomical loss that brings closer subjects with similar anatomical descriptors, and a y-Aware loss that does the same based on age. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR and Brain-MRI-SSL both use contrastive learning. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR uses SimCLR’s NT-Xent loss, which pulls together two views of the same scan and pushes apart different scans in a batch. Brain-MRI-SSL uses MoCov3’s symmetrized InfoNCE loss: each augmented view, encoded by a gradient-updated encoder, is contrasted against the other view produced by a momentum-updated encoder, with the other samples of the batch serving as negatives. In contrast, DINO-ViT relies on self-distillation. It minimizes the cross-entropy between a student network and a momentum teacher, without using negatives or labels. Finally, SAM-Med3D uses a supervised segmentation loss (Dice and cross-entropy). This diversity allows us to assess whether privacy risks persist across substantially different pretraining domains, architectures, and objectives.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价在培训前域、输入维度、架构和目标(表1)方面有差异的5个预训编码器:AnatCL(Barbano等,2026年),3D-神经-SimCLR (Kaczmarek等,2025年), Brain-MRI-SSL (黄等,2025年), DINO-ViT (Caron等,2021年), SAM-Med3D (Wang等,2024年). 前三项是专门在大脑核磁共振上预先训练的,而DINO-ViT则是在自然图像上预先训练的,而SAM-Med3D则是在各种医疗图像上训练的。 AnatCL,3D-神经-SimCLR,和SAM-Med3D过程全3D卷;而Brain-MRI-SSL和DINO-ViT则在2D图像上运行. 多数模型都受过自我监督目标的培训,以学习通用的表述,而SAM-Med3D则受到专门的培训,以监督的方式进行分化。 这些模型还使用不同的损失目标进行培训。 例如,对AnatCL的训练具有微弱的对比性损失,它结合了两个术语:一个是解剖学损失,它使实验对象与类似的解剖描述符更接近;另一个是y-Aware损失,它根据年龄做同样的事情. 3D-神经-SimCLR和Brain-MRI-SSL都采用对比学习. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR使用SimCLR的NT-Xent损失,该损失将同一扫描的两个视图汇聚在一起,分批推出不同的扫描. blocks.en: Datasets. We use two T1-weighted brain MRI datasets that were not included in the training data of any of our tested models: OASIS-2 ( Marcus et al., 2010 ) and MIRIAD ( Malone et al., 2013 ) , summarized in Table 2 . Both are longitudinal datasets including Alzheimer’s patients and healthy controls, but they differ substantially in scale and acquisition design. OASIS-2 includes more subjects (150) but fewer scans per subject (2–5 sessions), whereas MIRIAD includes fewer subjects (69) but with more repeated scans per subject (up to 12 scans over 9 visits, 708 scans in total). OASIS-2 scans are provided in a preprocessed form (motion-corrected, atlas-registered, skull-stripped, and intensity-corrected). Importantly, these are longitudinal acquisitions rather than near-duplicate acquisitions of the same scan: MIRIAD follow-ups are separated by approximately two weeks to two years, while OASIS-2 follow-ups extend over multiple years. The attack therefore evaluates whether subject-specific information persists across distinct acquisitions over time.

OASIS-2扫描以预处理形式提供(运动修正、地图册登记、头骨抽取和强度修正)。 重要的是,这些是纵向采购,而不是几乎重复地采购同一扫描:MIRIAD后续行动大约分两周至两年,而OASIS-2后续行动则分数年进行。 因此,这次攻击评估具体主题的信息是否长期存在于不同的采购过程中。

blocks.en: Embedding extraction. We apply model-specific preprocessing as described in its paper and extract one embedding per MRI scan. For Brain-MRI-SSL, we select 20 axial slices at fixed relative positions within the 25%–75% depth range of each volume. blocks.en: Attribute inference. For each evaluated encoder and dataset, we train a random forest predictor h h to infer the subject’s recorded sex from the extracted embeddings. We use subject-disjoint stratified cross-validation within each dataset: all scans from a given subject are assigned exclusively to either the training or held-out test, ensuring that no subject appears in both partitions. In each split, the training partition serves as the attribute-labeled auxiliary collection { ( z j ′ , a j ′ ) } \{(z^{\prime}_{j},a^{\prime}_{j})\} , while the held-out partition serves as the collection of released query embeddings. The predictor is fitted to the auxiliary embedding–label pairs and applied to each held-out embedding z i z_{i} to obtain a ^ i = h ⁡ ( z i ) \hat{a}_{i}=h(z_{i}) . The held-out attribute labels a i a_{i} are used only to evaluate the predictions, and subject identifiers are not predictor inputs. No query–reference matching or Canberra scoring is used in this attack: attribute inference operates directly on the released embeddings through the fitted predictor (see Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: 4 Privacy risk evaluation of pretrained brain representations
blocks.zh: 4 对经过培训的大脑表现进行隐私风险评估

blocks.en: We now evaluate the privacy risks defined in Section 3.2 . We first assess patient linkage and re-identification across the five pretrained encoders, then evaluate sensitive-attribute inference from the released embeddings. Finally, we discuss how differences in pretraining objectives may relate to the observed privacy risks.
blocks.zh: 我们现在评估第3.2节界定的隐私风险。 我们首先评估5个预先训练过的编码器的病人联系和重新识别,然后评估释放嵌入物的敏感属性推论。 最后,我们讨论培训前目标的差异如何与观察到的隐私风险相关。

blocks.en: 4.1 Patient Linkage and Re-identification
blocks.zh: 4.1 患者联系和重新识别

blocks.en: Table 3: Re-identification risk evaluation of the pretrained encoders on OASIS-2 and MIRIAD
blocks.zh: 表3:对OASIS-2和MIRIAD经过预先培训的编码器进行重新识别风险评估

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the results and some examples of the linkability plots are displayed in Appendix A.4 . For MIRIAD, the risk of re-identifying patients is high across all models, with both a high re-identification rate and high linkability. SAM-Med3D shows the lowest risk, with a re-identification rate above 89% and a linkability of 0.5139, which remains substantial. The other four models achieve a re-identification rate of at least 98% and a linkability of at least 0.79, with AnatCL and Brain-MRI-SSL showing the highest values and therefore being the least private. On OASIS-2, results vary more across models: AnatCL and DINO-ViT are the riskiest, with linkabilities of 0.9312 and 0.7796 and re-identification rates of 92.05% and 82.35%, respectively, while SAM-Med3D is again the safest, with a linkability of 0.2627 and a re-identification rate of only 13.94%.
blocks.zh: 表3报告结果和可连接地块的一些例子,见附录A.4。 对MIRIAD来说,在所有模型中重新识别患者的风险都很高,既具有较高的再识别率,又具有较高的可连接性. SAM-Med3D显示风险最低,重新识别率超过89%,可连接性为0.5139,仍然相当可观. 其他四种模式实现至少98%的再识别率,至少0.79的可连接性,AnatCL和Brain-MRI-SSL显示的值最高,因此是最不私人的. 在OASIS-2上,结果在各种模式上差异更大:AnatCL和DINO-ViT风险最大,连通性为0.9312和0.7796,再鉴定率分别为92.05%和82.35%,而SAM-Med3D再次是最安全的,可连通性为0.2627,再鉴定率仅为13.94%.

blocks.en: Although none of these models was trained for re-identification, their embeddings enable it, and most of them are therefore not privacy-safe. The lower risk of SAM-Med3D may be related to its training objective: it is the only model trained in a supervised manner for organ segmentation, so its embeddings are optimized for a different purpose. All the other models are self-supervised and not trained with a specific downstream task in mind. DINO-ViT and SAM-Med3D are the only two models not specific to brain MRI, and DINO-ViT is not even trained on medical images. Surprisingly, it still poses a considerable re-identification risk, higher on OASIS-2 than brain-specific models such as Brain-MRI-SSL and 3D-Neuro-SimCLR.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些模型都没有经过过重新识别的培训,但它们的嵌入使得它成为可能,因此,大多数模型都不安全。 SAM-Med3D的较低风险可能与其培训目标有关:它是唯一以监督方式培训用于器官分化的模型,因此其嵌入被优化用于不同目的. 所有其他模型都是自我监督的,没有经过训练,并牢记具体的下游任务. DINO-ViT和SAM-Med3D是唯一两个不特指脑磁共振的模型,而DINO-ViT甚至没有接受过医学影像的培训. 出人意料的是,它仍然构成相当大的重新识别风险,在OASIS-2上高于脑-MRI-SSL和3D-神经-SimCLR等针对大脑的模型.

blocks.en: Preprocessing may also contribute to these differences. Among the 3D models, AnatCL uses the most detailed pipeline: after nonlinear registration, it operates on gray matter maps, which describe the amount of gray matter at each location of the brain and therefore capture individual structural variations. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR uses skull-stripped and linearly registered volumes, and SAM-Med3D applies no brain-specific preprocessing. On OASIS-2, the risk follows this order, with a re-identification rate of 92.05% for AnatCL, 66.47% for 3D-Neuro-SimCLR, and 13.94% for SAM-Med3D. On MIRIAD, AnatCL and 3D-Neuro-SimCLR both reach near-complete re-identification, while SAM-Med3D remains the least risky.
blocks.zh: 预处理也可能造成这些差异。 在3D模型中,AnatCL使用最详细的管道:在非线性注册后,它运行在灰色物质地图上,它描述了大脑每个位置的灰色物质的数量并因此捕捉到单个的结构变化. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR使用头骨抽取和线性注册体积,而SAM-Med3D没有应用特定脑预处理. 在OASIS-2上,风险遵循这一顺序,AnatCL的重新识别率为92.05%,3D-神经-SimCLR为66.47%,SAM-Med3D为13.94%。 在MIRIAD上,AnatCL和3D-Neuro-SimCLR都接近完成再识别,而SAM-Med3D仍然是风险最小的.

blocks.en: AnatCL is among the riskiest models on both datasets (re-identification rate above 0.9). Performing re-identification using only the three descriptors, guiding its weakly contrastive training, yields results close to those obtained with the full AnatCL embeddings, suggesting that these anatomical features drive much of its risk. Overall, these results show that pretrained brain MRI encoders are not privacy-safe: their embeddings can be used to re-identify patients, even though none of these models was trained for this purpose. For a fair comparison with OASIS-2, we repeated the MIRIAD analysis with 2–5 scans per subject (Appendix A.3 ).
blocks.zh: AnatCL是两个数据集中风险最大的模型之一(再识别率高于0.9)。 仅使用三个描述符进行再鉴定,指导其微弱的对比性训练,得出的结果接近用全AnatCL嵌入法获得的结果,说明这些解剖特征驱动了它的很大风险. 总的来说,这些结果表明,预先训练的大脑核磁共振编码器不能保证隐私安全:它们的嵌入可以用来重新识别患者,尽管这些模型都没有为此进行过培训. 为了与OASIS-2进行公平比较,我们重复了MIRIAD分析,每个对象2至5个扫描(附录A.3)。

blocks.en: This linkability comparison can serve as a practical audit, allowing a hospital to decide whether a model requires additional protection before using it or sharing its embeddings. Risk varies across models: critical for AnatCL (above 0.93 on both datasets), consistently high for DINO-ViT (0.78–0.88), dataset-dependent for 3D-Neuro-SimCLR and Brain-MRI-SSL (0.79 and 0.85 on MIRIAD vs. 0.66 and 0.56 on OASIS-2), and lowest for SAM-Med3D, which still reaches 0.51 on MIRIAD and cannot be considered safe.
blocks.zh: 这种可关联性比较可以作为一种实际的审计,让医院在使用模型或分享其嵌入物之前决定一个模型是否需要额外的保护. 不同模型的风险各有不同:对AnatCL(两个数据集0.93以上)至关重要,对DINO-ViT(0.78-0.8)而言始终很高,对3D-Neuro-SimCLR和Brain-MRI-SSL(MIRIAD对0.66和OASIS-2的0.85)依赖数据集,对SAM-Med3D而言最低,对MIRIAD仍然达到0.51,不能视为安全。

blocks.en: We also evaluate an ad-hoc baseline representation following Bajar et al. (2026) , which consists of 15 features derived from FreeSurfer rather than a learned embedding. On MIRIAD, this representation reaches a linkability of 0.9797 and a re-identification rate of 99.93%. On OASIS-2, it remains highly identifying, with a linkability of 0.8134 and a re-identification rate of 75.00%. These 15 features are manually extracted anatomical measurements known to be highly distinctive. Yet deep learning models can extract more discriminative features unintentionally and reach similar and sometimes higher re-identification risk.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估Bajar等人(2026年)之后的临时基线代表,该代表由FreeSurfer产生的15个特征组成,而不是一个有学识的嵌入. 在MIRIAD,这种代表达到0.9797的可连接性,重新鉴定率为99.93%。 在OASIS-2上,它仍然高度识别,可连接性为0.8134,重新识别率为75.00%。 这15个特征是人工提取的解剖学测量结果,已知其高度独特. 然而,深入的学习模式可以无意中提取出更多的歧视性特征,并达到类似甚至更高的重新识别风险。

blocks.en: 4.2 Sensitive Attribute Inference
blocks.zh: 4.2 敏感属性推论

blocks.en: Table 4: Sex classification performance on OASIS-2 and MIRIAD.
blocks.zh: 表4:OASIS-2和MIRIAD的性别分类表现。

blocks.en: Beyond re-identification, we investigate whether these model embeddings also leak demographic attributes, specifically sex. We train a Random Forest classifier on top of the extracted embeddings to predict the subject’s sex. The classifier is evaluated using subject-disjoint stratified cross-validation, and we report balanced accuracy and precision as our metrics (Table 4 ). High classification performance indicates that sex-discriminative information is embedded in the representation, even though the foundation model was never explicitly trained for this task. This supports the claim that these embeddings encode more identity-linked information than intended, raising a further type of privacy risk beyond re-identification alone. Importantly, linkage and attribute inference do not induce the same ordering across representations. This indicates that privacy risk is multidimensional: reducing subject linkability does not necessarily reduce other sensitive information retained by the representation. Appendix A.2 reports the results when the classifier is trained on one dataset and tested on the other.
blocks.zh: 除了重新识别之外,我们调查这些模式嵌入是否也泄露出人口属性,特别是性特征. 我们训练一个随机森林分类器 在被提取的嵌入物之上 预测对象的性别。 分类器采用主题分离分级的交叉验证来评估,我们报告均衡的准确性和精确性作为我们的衡量标准(表4)。 高分级表现表明,性别歧视信息嵌入了代表性中,尽管基础模型从未为此任务受过明确培训. 这支持了这种说法,即这些嵌入式信息编码比预想的要多,除了重新识别之外,还带来了又一类隐私风险. 重要的是,联系和属性推论不会在陈述中引起同样的顺序。 这表明隐私风险是多层面的:降低主题关联性并不一定会减少代表保留的其他敏感信息. 附录A.2报告了分类员在一个数据集上接受培训并在另一个数据集上测试的结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Implications of pretraining objectives for privacy
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训前目标对隐私的影响

blocks.en: The evaluated encoders differ substantially in how their representations are learned, yet none is explicitly optimized to match longitudinal acquisitions from the same patient. This contrasts with biometric representation learning, where identity consistency is part of the objective. For example, Fallahi et al. (2026) train EEG encoders using supervised metric learning that brings recordings from the same subject across sessions closer while separating different subjects. In our setting, patient identity is never provided as supervision.
blocks.zh: 被评价的编码器在如何学习其表达方式方面差别很大,但没有任何编码器被明确优化,以配合同一患者的纵向获取。 这与生物鉴别表现学习形成对比,其中身份一致性是目标的一部分。 例如,Fallahi等人(2026年)使用有监督的计量学习方法培训EEG编码器,将同一课题的录音带近各会次,同时分离出不同的课题. 在我们的环境下,病人的身份从来不是作为监督的。

blocks.en: The contrastive models also differ in their training mechanism. Both 3D-Neuro-SimCLR and Brain-MRI-SSL treat augmented views of the same scan as positives and other scans as negatives, but 3D-Neuro-SimCLR optimizes an NT-Xent objective with a single shared encoder ( Kaczmarek et al., 2025 ) , whereas Brain-MRI-SSL follows MoCov3, in which keys are produced by a momentum encoder ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . These objectives are instance-based rather than identity-aware and do not explicitly encourage different acquisitions of the same subject to be close. If such acquisitions occur among the negatives, the objective may even discourage their similarity, depending on the pretraining sampling strategy. AnatCL instead guides contrastive learning using anatomical descriptors and age ( Barbano et al., 2026 ) ; DINO-ViT uses self-distillation across augmented views ( Caron et al., 2021 ) ; and SAM-Med3D is optimized for supervised segmentation ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 对比模型在培训机制上也有所不同. 3D-神经-SimCLR和Brain-MRI-SSL都把同一扫描的放大视图与正扫描相提并论,而3D-神经-SimCLR则以单一共享编码器优化了NT-Xent目标(Kaczmarek等,2025年),而Brain-MRI-SSL则遵循MoCov3,其中密钥由动力编码器产生(Huang等,2025年). 这些目标是以实例为依据的,而不是以对身份的认识为依据的,并且没有明确鼓励对同一标的进行不同的收购。 如果这种收购发生在负数之间,则目标甚至可能阻止它们的相似性,这取决于训练前的取样策略。 反之,AnatCL则用解剖描述和年龄来指导对比性学习(Barbano等,2026年);DINO-ViT使用自沉并跨增益视图(Caron等,2021年;SAM-Med3D被优化用于监督分化(Wang等,2024年)。

blocks.en: Despite these different learning signals, all evaluated representations retain subject-specific information supporting longitudinal linkage, although the magnitude varies across models and datasets. This suggests that such leakage is not specific to a particular contrastive formulation or the use of explicit negatives, but can arise as a by-product of preserving stable anatomical, structural, or instance-specific characteristics. AnatCL provides a direct example: although not designed for identity matching, its anatomical descriptors alone already support strong re-identification. However, because the encoders also differ in architecture, pretraining data, and preprocessing, differences in linkability cannot be attributed to the training objective alone.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些不同的学习信号,但所有被评价的表述都保留了支持纵向联系的针对具体主题的信息,尽管模型和数据集的规模各不相同. 这表明,这种渗漏并非是特定对比性配方或使用显性负子所特有的,而可能是保留稳定的解剖、结构或实例特性的副产品。 AnatCL提供了一个直接的例子:虽然它不是为身份匹配而设计的,但其解剖描述器本身已经支持了强烈的再识别. 然而,由于编码器在架构,预训数据,预处理方面也有差异,因此连通性的差异不能仅仅归因于培训目标.

blocks.en: These findings have implications for both privacy-oriented representation learning and AI governance. An identity-agnostic objective should not be assumed to produce an identity-invariant representation, motivating privacy-aware training or post-hoc sanitization of released embeddings. For high-risk AI systems, Article 9 of the EU AI Act requires an iterative process for identifying and evaluating reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety, and fundamental rights and adopting appropriate risk-management measures ( European Union, 2024 ) . Privacy audits such as the linkage and attribute-inference evaluations considered here can provide technical evidence of residual risks before deployment or release, complementing the data-protection assessment of linkage and inference risks discussed earlier ( European Data Protection Board, 2026 ) , without by themselves establishing regulatory compliance or anonymity.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果对注重隐私的代表性学习和AI治理都有影响。 不应假定身份不可知的目标产生身份不常见的表述,激发对隐私的认识培训,或对释放的嵌入物进行隔离后消毒。 就高风险AI系统而言,《欧盟AI法》第9条要求有一个迭接程序,以查明和评估可合理预见的健康、安全和基本权利风险,并采取适当的风险管理措施(欧洲联盟,2024年)。 隐私审计,如本文中考虑的关联和属性推论评价,可在部署或发布前提供剩余风险的技术证据,补充上文讨论的关联和推断风险的数据保护评估(欧洲数据保护委员会,2026年),而本身并不确立监管合规或匿名。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We audited whether released representations from frozen pretrained encoders retain patient-specific information in longitudinal brain MRI. Across five encoders and two T1-weighted datasets, we find that several representations support strong patient linkage and re-identification under the evaluated threat model, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We also show that released embeddings retain information predictive of the subject’s recorded sex, extending the privacy risk beyond identity linkage alone. These findings indicate that releasing learned representations instead of raw brain MRI does not, by itself, eliminate linkage or attribute-inference risk and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.
blocks.zh: 我们审计了被冻结的预导编码器释放的表达是否保留了纵向脑磁共振中针对患者的信息。 在5个编码器和2个T1加权数据集中,我们发现,尽管在编码器培训过程中没有识别目标,但若干表述支持在评估的威胁模型下建立强有力的病人联系和重新识别。 我们还显示,释放的嵌入物保留了预测被试者所记录性别的信息,将隐私风险扩大到了仅身份联系之外. 这些调查结果表明,释放学到的表述而不是生脑核磁共振本身并不能消除联系或属性推论风险,因此本身不足以确定匿名性。

blocks.en: Our study is limited to two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, five pretrained encoders, and one inferred attribute. Moreover, the evaluated models differ simultaneously in architecture, pretraining domain, and objective, so our comparisons should not be interpreted as isolating the causal effect of any single design choice. Future work should move from measuring privacy risk to reducing it through privacy-aware training objectives and post-hoc sanitization methods that suppress identity-bearing information in released embeddings. An important next step is to evaluate how effectively these approaches reduce privacy risks while preserving downstream utility.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究仅限于两个纵向T1加权数据集,五个预训编码器和一个推断属性. 此外,评估模型在结构、培训前领域和客观方面同时不同,因此我们的比较不应被解释为孤立任何单一设计选择的因果关系。 今后的工作应当从衡量隐私风险转向通过了解隐私的培训目标和在释放嵌入物中压制含身份信息的隔离后消毒方法来减少隐私风险。 下一步的一个重要步骤是评估这些方法如何在保护下游效用的同时有效地减少隐私风险。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies privacy risks in released brain MRI representations using existing research datasets and does not attempt to identify participants in the real world. Our re-identification evaluation is performed at the dataset-subject level: the experiments measure whether different scans can be linked to the same subject, while attribution to a real-world identity is considered only as an explicit assumption in the threat model when identity-linked auxiliary information is available. We do not recover names or other civil identifiers, nor do we release patient-level linkage results. The purpose of the study is to characterize potential privacy risks and inform safer sharing of medical-image representations; all reported results are presented in aggregate.
blocks.zh: 这项工作利用现有的研究数据集,研究释放出脑磁共振表达中的隐私风险,并不试图识别现实世界的参与者. 我们的再识别评价是在数据集-主体层面进行的:实验测量不同的扫描能否与同一个主体相连接,而归属到现实世界的身份只在存在身份关联辅助信息时被视为威胁模型中的一种明确假设. 我们不恢复姓名或其他民事识别资料,也不公布病人一级的联系结果。 研究的目的是描述潜在的隐私风险,并为更安全地分享医疗图像表述提供信息;所有报告的结果都是汇总的。

blocks.en: A.1 Ablation: Distance Metric
blocks.zh: A.1 差额: 距离测量

blocks.en: To assess the sensitivity of our results to the similarity function, we compare Canberra-based and cosine similarity in Table 5 . Canberra yields higher linkability for every encoder on both datasets, indicating greater separation between the same-subject and different-subject score distributions under this metric. Rank-1 matching is less sensitive to this choice: neither similarity function consistently dominates across all model–dataset combinations, although Canberra achieves slightly higher performance overall. We therefore retain Canberra for the main analysis because it consistently provides the stronger linkability audit while supporting comparable rank-1 matching results.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的结果对相似性函数的敏感性,我们在表5中比较了基于堪培拉的和同位素相似性。 堪培拉在两个数据集上,每个编码器的链接性都较高,表明在这一度量下,同一主标和不同主标的分数分布之间有较大的分离. 排名1比对这个选择不太敏感:虽然堪培拉的总体表现略高,但在所有模型-数据集组合中,两者的相似性功能都一直占主导地位。 因此,我们保留堪培拉进行主要分析,因为它一贯提供更有力的关联性审计,同时支持可比的一等匹配结果。

blocks.zh: 表5:在堪培拉和同位素相似的情况下的关联性和一级匹配。 粗体标出每对的较高值(即更强的攻击).

blocks.en: A.2 Cross Dataset Attribute Inference
blocks.zh: A.2 交叉数据集属性推论

blocks.en: In Section 4.2 , we showed that the evaluated embeddings retain information predictive of recorded sex when the classifier is trained and tested within the same dataset. We now examine whether this information generalizes across cohorts by training on one dataset and testing on the other. Table 6 reports results in both directions, where A → \rightarrow B denotes training on dataset A and testing on dataset B. Balanced accuracy decreases for every encoder under cross-dataset evaluation, with most models approaching chance level ( 0.5 0.5 ) in at least one direction. SAM-Med3D is the main exception, retaining balanced accuracy of 0.81 for OASIS-2 → \rightarrow MIRIAD and 0.79 for MIRIAD → \rightarrow OASIS-2, compared with 0.86–0.89 within datasets. Interestingly, this differs from the linkage results, where SAM-Med3D exhibited the lowest linkability and rank-1 matching among the evaluated encoders, further showing that different privacy risks need not induce the same ordering across representations. Cross-dataset performance is also asymmetric: training on MIRIAD and testing on OASIS-2 performs better than the reverse for all encoders except SAM-Med3D. This asymmetry suggests sensitivity to dataset-specific factors such as preprocessing, acquisition conditions, and cohort characteristics; however, our experiments do not isolate which of these factors drives the observed domain shift.
blocks.zh: 在第4.2节中,我们显示,当分类员在同一数据集内接受培训和测试时,被评价的嵌入保留了记录性的信息预测。 我们现在审查这一信息是否通过对一个数据集进行培训和对另一个数据集进行测试,使所有群体普遍了解。 表6报告的结果是双向的,其中A-\正弦B表示对数据集A进行培训和对数据集B进行测试。 在跨数据集评价下,每个编码器的平衡准确度都下降,大多数模型至少在一个方向接近机会水平(0.5 0.5)。 SAM-Med3D是主要例外,在OASIS-2 →\右翼MIRIAD 和 MIRIAD →\右翼OASIS-2 中保持平衡精度为0.81;而在数据集中则保持了0.86–0.89. 有趣的是,这与链接结果不同,SAM-Med3D在被评价的编码器中表现出最低的可链接性和一等相匹配性,进一步表明不同的隐私风险不需要在各种表述中诱发相同的顺序. 跨数据集性能也不对称:除SAM-Med3D外,所有编码器在MIRIAD的培训和OASIS-2的测试上的表现优于反. 这种不对称表明对数据集特定因素的敏感性,如预处理、获取条件和组群特征;然而,我们的实验并不孤立这些因素中哪些因素驱动所观察到的域转移。

blocks.en: A.3 Ablation: Impact of Number of Scans
blocks.zh: A.3 扫描次数的影响

blocks.en: MIRIAD contains more repeated scans per subject than OASIS-2, which may increase the success of a retrieval-based matching attack by providing more genuine references in the gallery. To assess the effect of this difference, we repeat the MIRIAD analysis after randomly subsampling each subject to between 2 and 5 scans, matching the range observed in OASIS-2. We repeat the subsampling ten times and report the mean and standard deviation for each model.
blocks.zh: MIRIAD包含的每个主题的重复扫描比OASIS-2要多,这可以通过在画廊中提供更真实的参考,提高基于检索的匹配攻击的成功. 为了评估这一差异的影响,我们重复MIRIAD分析,在随机对每个主体进行2至5个扫描的分样后,与OASIS-2观察到的范围相匹配. 我们重复10次子抽样,并报告每个模型的平均值和标准差。

blocks.en: Table 7: Re-identification risk on MIRIAD: full dataset vs. capped (2–5 scans per subject). Capped results are reported as mean ± \pm std over 10 random subsamplings.
blocks.zh: 表7:MIRIAD上的重新识别风险:全数据集与封顶(每个主体2至5个扫描). 封面结果报告为平均值±\\pm std 在10个随机分样本上.

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that capping the number of scans lowers the re-identification rate for all models, but to very different extents. AnatCL, DINO-ViT, and Brain-MRI-SSL are only mildly affected, with drops of 0.9, 2.0, and 4.7 percentage points, respectively. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR drops by 6.3 points and SAM-Med3D, already the least risky model, drops by far the most, by 27.1% (from 89.58% to 62.46%). Linkability, in contrast, remains almost unchanged for all models except 3D-Neuro-SimCLR, varying by less than 0.01. Although SAM-Med3D loses 27.1 points in re-identification rate, its linkability remains essentially stable. Unlike rank-1 matching, linkability measures the separation between empirical same-subject and different-subject score distributions rather than retrieval success from a gallery. Subsampling can nevertheless alter these distributions by changing which acquisitions and pairwise comparisons are retained.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,封顶扫描次数会降低所有模型的再识别率,但程度非常不同. AnatCL,DINO-ViT和Brain-MRI-SSL只受到轻度影响,分别下降0.9分,2.0分和4.7分. 3D-Neuro-SimCLR下降6.3分,SAM-Med3D已经是风险最小的模型,下降幅度最大,为27.1%(从89.58%下降到62.46%). 相形之下,除3D-神经-SimCLR外,所有型号的可连接性几乎保持不变,相差小于0.01. 虽然SAM-Med3D在再识别率上损失了27.1分,但其可连接性仍然基本稳定. 与一等相匹配不同,可连接性衡量经验类同题和不同题分数分布之间的分出,而不是从一个画廊取回成功. 然而,子抽样仍可通过改变保留哪些采购和对等比较来改变这些分配。

blocks.en: Two factors may explain why MIRIAD remains riskier than OASIS-2 even after capping the number of scans. First, MIRIAD scans of the same subject are acquired close together in time and are therefore very similar, whereas OASIS-2 scans are spaced at least one year apart. Second, all MIRIAD scans are released without preprocessing. OASIS-2 is released already preprocessed (motion-corrected, registered, and skull-stripped). This prior preprocessing may remove identifying information that is still present in the raw MIRIAD scans.
blocks.zh: 有两个因素可以解释为什么MIRIAD即使在封顶扫描次数后仍然比OASIS-2风险更大. 首先,同一对象的MIRIAD扫描在时间上是相近的,因此非常相近,而OASIS-2扫描相距至少一年. 其二,所有MIRIAD扫描都发布,不进行预处理. OASIS-2的发布已经经过预处理(运动修正、登记和头骨抽取)。 此先前的预处理可能会去除原始MIRIAD扫描中仍然存在的识别信息.

blocks.en: The number of scans per subject therefore contributes to re-identification, but other dataset-specific factors also shape the results. This does not change our overall conclusion: re-identification remains high for all models, confirming our finding that the embeddings of these pretrained encoders are not privacy-safe.
blocks.zh: 因此,每个主体的扫描次数有助于重新识别,但其他数据集特定因素也决定了结果. 这并没有改变我们的总体结论: 对所有模型的重新识别仍然很高, 证实了我们的结论, 这些预先训练的编码器的嵌入 并不安全。
